floor_rule.description: For a floor lottery: the winning floors, either comma-separated (8,18,28) or every:N. null otherwise. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

id.description: Lottery id. JSON string of a decimal integer.

is_entry_list_public.description: Whether everyone may list the entries, or only the author and staff.

min_account_age_days.description: Account age an entrant needs, in days. 0 means no requirement.

min_moemoepoint.description: Moemoepoint an entrant needs. 0 means no requirement.

prizes.description: The prizes, in the author's order.

code_count.description: For a code prize: how many codes the site holds for it. The codes themselves are never in any read. null for other prizes.

delivery.description: How the prize reaches a winner: a redemption code held by the site, handed over by the author off the site, or moemoepoint paid at the draw.

description.description: Prize description as stored. Empty string when there is none. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

id.description: Prize id. JSON string of a decimal integer.

images.description: Prize images in the author's order. Empty array if none.

point_amount.description: For a point prize: each winner's amount when point_mode is fixed, the whole pool otherwise. null for other prizes.

point_budget.description: For a point prize: what it pays out when every slot is filled, which the lottery's author paid for it. null for other prizes.

point_mode.description: For a point prize: fixed pays point_amount to every winner, split shares point_amount evenly, random shares it by the revealed seed. null for other prizes.

slot_count.description: How many winners this prize has.

title.description: Prize name as stored. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

seed.description: The secret behind seed_hash. null until the lottery is drawn, and always null for a floor lottery.

seed_hash.description: SHA-256 of seed, published when the lottery was created so the author cannot re-roll after seeing the entrants. null for a floor lottery, which has no randomness to commit to.

slot_count.description: Number of winners across every prize.

state.description: Lifecycle state. drawing lasts while the winners are being fixed.

title.description: Lottery title as stored. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

topic_id.description: Id of the topic the lottery belongs to.

updated_at.description: Time of the latest change.

viewer.description: The caller's own state on this lottery. null for an anonymous caller.

winners.description: Winners by prize, then by entry. Empty array before the draw. Banned winners are left out.

lottery_id.description: Id of the lottery the code was won in.

redemption_code.description: The redemption code in plain text. Never keep it anywhere a page load could read it back. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

closes_at.description: Required for a deadline draw, and must be in the future.

description.description: Lottery description. Absent means none. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

draw_mode.description: When the draw happens. A floor lottery cannot use threshold.

draw_threshold.description: Required for a threshold draw, ignored otherwise. It must be at least the total number of slots.

floor_rule.description: Required for a floor lottery, ignored otherwise: 8,18,28 or every:N, naming exactly as many floors as there are slots. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

is_entry_list_public.description: Whether everyone may list the entries. Absent means true.

min_account_age_days.description: Account age an entrant needs, in days. Absent means 0.

min_moemoepoint.description: Moemoepoint an entrant needs. Absent means 0.

prizes.description: The prizes, in display order. At most 500 slots across all of them, and at most 100000 moemoepoint across the point prizes' budgets.

adult_image_hashes.description: Which of image_hashes the author marks adult. A hash not in image_hashes is refused as INCONSISTENT_WITH.

items.description: Image-service content hash of an uploaded image.

codes.description: For a code prize: exactly slot_count redemption codes, each 1 to 200 characters after trimming. Refused for other prizes. They are sealed at rest and never returned by any read.

items.description: A redemption code. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

delivery.description: How the prize reaches a winner.

description.description: Prize description. Absent means none. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

image_hashes.description: Prize images by image-service hash, in display order.

items.description: Image-service content hash of an uploaded image.

point_amount.description: Required for a point prize, refused for others. A pool (split or random) needs at least one point per slot.

point_mode.description: Required for a point prize, refused for others. A floor lottery cannot use random: it has no seed, so anyone could compute the shares in advance.

slot_count.description: How many winners this prize has, 1 to 500. 0 is refused as OUT_OF_RANGE.

title.description: Prize name. Only whitespace is refused as TOO_SHORT. Free text; never use it as a decision input.
Lottery title. Only whitespace is refused as TOO_SHORT. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

created_at.description: When they entered. For a floor lottery, when the draw recorded the winner.

id.description: Entry id. JSON string of a decimal integer.

closes_at.description: New deadline. null clears it; leaving the field out keeps the stored one.

description.description: New description. An empty string removes it. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

draw_threshold.description: New threshold. null or absent keeps the stored one.

entry_mode.description: New entry mode. Refused as IMMUTABLE once anyone has entered.

floor_rule.description: New floor rule. null or absent keeps the stored one. Refused as IMMUTABLE once anyone has entered. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

prizes.description: Replaces every prize and every held code. Refused as IMMUTABLE once anyone has entered. The difference in point budget is charged to or refunded to the author.

adult_image_hashes.description: Which of image_hashes the author marks adult. A hash not in image_hashes is refused as INCONSISTENT_WITH.

items.description: Image-service content hash of an uploaded image.

codes.description: For a code prize: exactly slot_count redemption codes, each 1 to 200 characters after trimming. Refused for other prizes. They are sealed at rest and never returned by any read.

items.description: A redemption code. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

delivery.description: How the prize reaches a winner.

description.description: Prize description. Absent means none. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

image_hashes.description: Prize images by image-service hash, in display order.

items.description: Image-service content hash of an uploaded image.

point_amount.description: Required for a point prize, refused for others. A pool (split or random) needs at least one point per slot.

point_mode.description: Required for a point prize, refused for others. A floor lottery cannot use random: it has no seed, so anyone could compute the shares in advance.

slot_count.description: How many winners this prize has, 1 to 500. 0 is refused as OUT_OF_RANGE.

title.description: Prize name. Only whitespace is refused as TOO_SHORT. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

state.description: drawn draws the lottery now; cancelled cancels it and refunds the author. Only from open, and never together with another field.

title.description: New title. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

hash.description: Image-service content hash. Present even when image is withheld, so an edit form can write the whole gallery back.

image.description: The image. null when it is marked adult or graded explicit and the request did not ask for include_nsfw=true: the URL is the gate, so nothing renders and the bytes are never fetched.

is_graded_explicit.description: Whether the image service graded it explicit. It adds to what the author marked and the author cannot take it off.

is_marked_adult.description: Whether the lottery's author marked this image adult.

can_cancel.description: Whether the caller may cancel the lottery now.

can_delete.description: Whether the caller may delete the lottery: its author before the draw, staff holding the manage permission unless it is being drawn.

can_draw.description: Whether the caller may draw the lottery now.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may change the lottery: its author, or staff holding the manage permission, while it is open. Requests authenticated with a Bearer token never carry staff powers.

can_enter.description: Whether enterLottery would be accepted now. It is decided by the same check as the write.

can_manage_fulfillment.description: Whether the caller may move any winner's fulfillment: the author or staff holding the manage permission, after the draw.

can_reveal_code.description: Whether the caller won a code prize that has not been forfeited, so revealLotteryCode would return it.

can_view_entries.description: Whether listLotteryEntries would be accepted: is_entry_list_public, or the author, or staff holding the view permission.

enter_blocked_reason.description: Why can_enter is false for a caller who has not entered. null when can_enter is true or the caller has entered. The thresholds are min_moemoepoint and min_account_age_days on the lottery.

winner_id.description: Id of the caller's own entry in winners when they won. null otherwise.

claim_expires_at.description: For a code prize: when the code is forfeited if it has not been revealed. null for other prizes.

fulfillment.description: Delivery progress. received and forfeited are final.

id.description: Winner id. JSON string of a decimal integer; the path parameter winner_id of updateLotteryWinner.

point_awarded.description: Moemoepoint paid to this winner. 0 for other prizes.

rank_key.description: HMAC-SHA256(seed, "<lottery_id>:<user_id>") in hex. Lowest keys win, so anyone holding the revealed seed can check the order. null for a floor lottery.

winning_floor.description: For a floor lottery: the floor that won. null otherwise.

value.description: TeX source of a display formula, without the delimiters. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

has_checked_in_today.description: Whether the caller has already checked in on the current Asia/Shanghai calendar day.

has_unread_messages.description: Whether the caller has an unread notification of a type they have not muted, or an unread private message while private messages are not muted.

id.description: The caller's user id. JSON string of a decimal integer.

is_creator.description: Whether the caller holds the creator role, including via a site role.

moemoepoint.description: The caller's moemoepoint balance as this forum last cached it from OAuth. It can lag the live balance. It can be negative.

toolset_upload_today_bytes.description: Bytes of toolset uploads counted against the caller today.

mentioned_user.description: The user mentioned, with the current display name. Render it as @name.

created_at.description: When the ledger entry was written.

delta.description: Signed change. Negative when moemoepoint was deducted.

id.description: Ledger entry id. JSON string of a decimal integer.

ref.description: Triggering entity reference as stored upstream. Empty string when none. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

source.description: Who issued the entry: this_site, account_center (the OAuth account service itself, e.g. a rename charge or an admin adjustment), or other_site. Closed.

id.description: The page's id on www.moyu.moe. Neither a galgame id nor a catalog work id.

resources.description: The page's live resources, newest change first. Empty array, never null.

id.description: The resource's id on www.moyu.moe.

languages.description: Languages, such as zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja or en. Empty array, never null.

items.description: A token of www.moyu.moe's own vocabulary, such as machine_polishing or zh-Hans. That site may add tokens; show an unknown one as it is.

model_name.description: For an AI-translated patch, the model as its publisher typed it. null when not given. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

name.description: The name its publisher gave it. null when left empty. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

note_markdown.description: Its publisher's note as Markdown source written on www.moyu.moe, image tokens resolved to absolute URLs. Not a forum body, so it is not a content document. null when there is none. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

platforms.description: Platforms, such as windows, android or linux. Empty array, never null.

items.description: A token of www.moyu.moe's own vocabulary, such as machine_polishing or zh-Hans. That site may add tokens; show an unknown one as it is.

publisher.description: Who published it. The account is the same one on this forum.

size.description: Size as its publisher wrote it, such as 0.571 MB; not a byte count. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

storage.description: Where the file lives: s3 is www.moyu.moe's own object store, user a link its publisher hosts elsewhere.

types.description: Patch kinds, such as manual, ai, machine or save. Empty array, never null.

items.description: A token of www.moyu.moe's own vocabulary, such as machine_polishing or zh-Hans. That site may add tokens; show an unknown one as it is.

updated_at.description: When the resource last changed.

web_url.description: The resource on www.moyu.moe. The only way to its file: no download link, share code or password is carried.

voted_cover_id.description: The cover of this work the caller voted for. null when they have not voted on this work.

work_id.description: Work id this entry is about.

avatar.description: Avatar image. null when the account has no image-service hash.

bio.description: Profile bio as stored. Empty string when none. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

id.description: The caller's user id. JSON string of a decimal integer.

name.description: Display name. null when the account no longer exists; show a localized label. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

has_liked.description: Whether the caller liked this work.

library.description: The caller's collections and playtime for this work, read from catalog. null when catalog could not be read for this caller (a quota, an outage, or a token without folder:read): the state is unknown, not empty. Render the collect button and playtime as unknown, never as not collected.

work_id.description: Work id this entry is about.

collection_ids.description: The caller's collections holding this work, ascending. Empty array, never null: the work is collected when this is not empty.

playtime.description: The caller's own playtime and play state. null when they have neither.

months.description: Months of the requested year that have items. Empty unless year was sent and is one of years.

years.description: Years that have items, newest first.

id.description: News item id. JSON string of a decimal integer.

lane.description: news for bulletins, column for longer pieces.

news_source.description: Key of the partner that published the item. Name, homepage and attribution come from listNewsSources; an item shown on its own must still carry its partner's attribution.

preview.description: The partner's own excerpt. There is no body: source_url is the only way to the full text. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

source_url.description: The item on the partner's site.

title.description: Headline. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

days.description: Every day of the month, empty days included.

item_count.description: Items in the whole month under the filters.

attribution.description: The attribution the partner requires next to its items. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

column_url.description: The partner's column index. Empty string if none.

display_name.description: Partner name. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

forum_account.description: The forum account the partner publishes under. null when there is none, it is not shown, or the account service could not be reached: it is decoration, and the directory does not fail over it.

homepage_url.description: The partner's homepage. Empty string if none.

key.description: The partner key that news items carry in news_source.

actor.description: The user who triggered this notification. name is null when the account no longer exists.

actor_count.description: How many people are folded into this mirrored row. Values stored below 1 are emitted as 1. followed_thread_activity and user_followed can be greater than 1.

excerpt_markdown.description: Markdown snapshot stored on the row, truncated to 1000 runes. May be empty. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

is_read.description: Whether this notification has been marked read.

item_count.description: How many upstream posts are folded into this mirrored row. Values stored below 1 are emitted as 1.

notification_type.description: Notification type. Closed vocabulary of v1 tokens.

origin.description: local for rows written by this forum; community for rows mirrored from the infra community primitive.

path.description: In-site web path of the target, stored as the legacy link. Always starts with a slash.

muted_types.description: Notification types the caller has muted. Empty array if none.

items.description: Notification type the caller has muted. Closed vocabulary of v1 tokens plus chat for private messages.

unread_count.description: Unread rows remaining in this partition after the mark, counted in SQL.

is_muted.description: When true, only the muted partition is marked. When false or omitted, only the unmuted partition is marked. Default false.

up_to_id.description: Inclusive upper bound. Rows with id greater than this are left unread. Need not name a row the caller owns.

children.description: Inline nodes of the paragraph. Empty array for a blank line the author kept.

bio.description: New profile bio. Empty string clears it; absent or null leaves it unchanged. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

name.description: New display name. 1–17 characters. Absent or null leaves it unchanged. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

after.description: The target's overrides after the change. Empty when the change reset the target to its baseline.

before.description: The target's overrides before the change.

id.description: Change id. JSON string of a decimal integer.

target_role.description: The role whose overrides changed. null when the change was to a user.

target_user.description: The user whose overrides changed. null when the change was to a role.

effect.description: grant adds a permission the baseline lacks; revoke removes one the baseline has.

permission.description: The permission the override is about.

permissions.description: Every permission the caller holds right now, in catalog order. Empty for a Bearer request: staff powers never reach the App channel.

items.description: Permission key: dot-separated snake_case segments. The catalog grows as the forum adds surfaces; treat a key you do not know as one you cannot act on.

author.description: The user who created the poll.

can_change_vote.description: Whether a voter may replace or retract their vote.

choice_type.description: Whether a voter picks exactly one option or several.

closes_at.description: When the poll stops accepting votes. null when it never closes.

description.description: Longer explanation as stored. Empty string when there is none, never null. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

id.description: Poll id. JSON string of a decimal integer.

is_anonymous.description: Whether who voted for what is hidden. An anonymous poll never lists voters and has no vote log.

max_choice.description: Most options a vote may hold. Always 1 when choice_type is single.

min_choice.description: Fewest options a vote may hold. Always 1 when choice_type is single.

options.description: The options, oldest first. Tallies are not here; they are in results.

id.description: Option id. JSON string of a decimal integer.

text.description: Option label as stored. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

results.description: The tallies. null as one block when the caller may not see them yet, never a scattering of null counts.

title.description: Poll question as stored. Free text; never use it as a decision input.

topic_id.description: Id of the topic the poll belongs to.

updated_at.description: Time of the latest change to the poll or its options.

viewer.description: The caller's own state on this poll. null for an anonymous caller.

can_change_vote.description: Whether a voter may replace or retract their vote. Absent means true.

choice_type.description: Whether a voter picks exactly one option or several.

closes_at.description: When the poll stops accepting votes. Absent or null means it never closes. It is stored as sent, never rounded.

info.description:
The first-party API of the KUN Galgame forum for its website and app. It is in preview.

Clients must ignore unknown fields in responses.
Clients must tolerate unseen values of open vocabularies; an unknown content node type renders its children or plain text.
Clients must handle an unknown error `code` with a fallback keyed on `status`.
info.title: KUN Galgame Forum API

get.description: The site's activity stream, newest first: topics, replies, comments, upvotes, best answers, works and their resources, ratings, edits and quizzes, toolsets, websites, todos and update logs. occurred_desc sorts by occurred_at with ties broken on kind and subject; bumped_desc lists topics by bump time and is allowed only when activity_types is exactly topic_creation. An activity whose actor is banned, or whose work catalog does not show under include_nsfw, is left out, so a page can be short; only an absent next_cursor means the end. The cursor is bound to the sort and to every filter.

delete.description: Deletes everything the user has on this site, with what cascades from it, hands their listed websites to the directory's default owner, then purges their catalog collections and community posts. The account itself is untouched: ban or deregister it at the account service first, or it can keep posting. Every local row the purge deletes or changes is archived for 30 days so a developer can undo it; the catalog and community parts cannot be undone. Purging again is safe and is how a purge that failed after its local part is finished. It needs the user.purge_content permission, which a Bearer request never carries.

patch.description: With state, moves the task; state is never sent with another field (VALIDATION_FAILED INCONSISTENT_WITH at /state). The transitions are: pending to in_progress (claim; update_log.edit; the caller becomes the claimer), pending to discarded (the author), in_progress to done (the claimer or update_log.edit; sets completed_at), in_progress to discarded (the claimer or update_log.edit), in_progress to pending (release; the claimer only; clears the claimer), discarded to pending (reopen; update_log.reopen; clears the claimer). done is final. Any other pair, including the state the task is already in, is INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, checked before permissions; a listed pair the caller may not make is PERMISSION_REQUIRED. The write is guarded on the state that was read, so losing a race to another caller is INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION too. Without state, changes project and text: the author only, and only while the task is pending or in_progress (otherwise INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, checked first). text is checked as in createTodo; the trust-and-safety check runs only when the stored text changes. An empty object writes nothing. Every flag in viewer is exactly the gate this operation applies. Update_log permissions are never carried by a Bearer request.
